scusa-1989.notes: Source 1 is the collection front page of The Rice Thresher newspaper on the Portal to Texas History; a specific 1989 issue reporting the contest would be a report source, but the collection page itself is not a source. The browse/filter pages in our copy are bot-check pages.

sources.evidence: Our copy is the Portal to Texas History collection page of The Rice Thresher (Rice University's student newspaper, 2,954 issues) plus a statistics page, with the browse pages all bot-check pages ('Validating your request...'); no file mentions a programming contest.

scusa-1991.notes: Source 1 (usenetarchives.com thread view): our copy is the page shell without the post, which the site fills in by script; a new capture (or another archive of the comp.org.acm post) is needed for the standings.

sources.evidence: Usenet Archives 'COMP.ORG.ACM - Thread View' page whose 'Posts:' area is empty: only the site's menus, an abuse form and an about text, with no word of the contest or any post.

scusa-1997.notes: Five Baekjoon Wayback copies (problems 1, 2, 3, 5, 6) whose source line names 1997 South Central USA Regional Programming Contest; titles agree with the catalogue. The pack's contest name is empty; the Baekjoon source lines call it '1997 South Central USA Regional Programming Contest'.
